data.one_liner: Streamlines multi-chain blockchain operations for Ethereum, Tron, Solana, Cardano, Aptos, and Sui.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for creating transactions, interacting with smart contracts, managing wallets, and signing data across multiple major blockchain ecosystems. It handles era-specific transaction building, serialization, and node communication in Dart.
use_when: You need to build a cross-chain wallet or interact with multiple blockchains like Ethereum, Solana, and Cardano within a single Dart application.
You require granular transaction construction, smart contract invocation, and cryptographic signing without running a local node.
avoid_when: You only need to interact with a single blockchain and can use a smaller, dedicated client library.
You require complex state management or high-level UI widgets for crypto operations.
strengths: Supports multiple major blockchains (Ethereum, Tron, Solana, Cardano, Aptos, Sui) in a unified SDK.
Comprehensive feature set including HD-Wallets, smart contract interaction, and advanced transaction serialization.
weaknesses: Large dependency surface area across diverse blockchain ecosystems.
Breaking updates across major version bumps require careful code review of transaction models.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml dependencies and import as needed. No native platform permissions or build_runner required.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick web3dart if your project is exclusively focused on Ethereum and you prefer a dedicated Ethereum ecosystem library.

alternatives.name: blockchain_utils
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick blockchain_utils if you only need lower-level cryptographic primitives, address encoding, and BIP/HD wallet helpers without full network transaction builders.
